当作终端里的队友，并为它提供明确的项目上下文时，它的效果最佳。先用 <code>/init</code> 开始；面对大型或不确定的修改时使用 <code>/plan</code>；用 <code>/tasks</code> 关注长时间运行的任务；长会话里随时善用 <code>/compact</code>；并根据仓库的可信程度选择合适的权限模式。</p></div><div answer-text--open">是的。Kimi Code CLI 是开源的，可免费安装。底层模型或服务的访问权限可能取决于你的 Kimi Code 套餐。详情请参阅 <a href="https://www.kimi.ai/code" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-(--Labels-Primary)">为什么这个页面叫快速参考，而不只叫速查表？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">“快速参考”是更正式、更偏文档风格的名称。本页依然满足速查表的用途：把可复制粘贴的命令、斜杠命令、快捷键、工具和工作流集中在一处。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">安装 Kimi Code CLI 需要 Node.js 吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">官方安装脚本不需要 Node.js。npm 和 pnpm 安装方式需要 Node.js 环境，因为它们使用 JavaScript 包管理器。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-4" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">`/plan` 和普通模式有什么区别？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-4" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">普通模式让 Agent 直接开展工作。Plan Mode 适用于范围大、风险高或不明确的任务：Kimi Code 会先探索、写出计划，并在计划获批后退出。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-5" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">如何继续之前的会话？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">在同一项目目录中运行 <code>kimi --continue</code> 可继续最近一次会话。要选择特定会话，可在 shell 中使用 <code>kimi --session [id]</code>，或在 TUI 内使用 <code>/sessions</code>。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-6" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">`--yolo` 安全吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-6" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div "><code>--yolo</code> 会跳过常规工具调用的审批。只应在可信且受版本控制的工作区使用。面对不熟悉的仓库或生产数据时，请保持审批开启。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-7" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">技能和 MCP 在 Kimi Code 中如何配合？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-7" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid
